name: Eleonora Vletoblood
original_name: エレオノーラ・ヴレトブラッ
source: The spoiled and condescending vampire. She's at odds with [url=/c41438]Ooko[/url] especially. She transfers into the school and immediately starts to antagonize the wolf girl. She wants to prove her superiority by stealing anything Ooko loves. Has the ability to hypnotize humans.
